"""Fixed-source completion-report counterexample; fake procfs/status transitions only."""
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from types import ModuleType
from unittest import mock
import hashlib
import json
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT=Path("/workspace/scratch/d417066aafa8")
OUT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
HEAD="955d982448d88fa297b91ee8544d04cc1af1a9ed"
SOURCE=ROOT/"agent-dev-kit/tests/test_skill_command_examples.py"
raw=subprocess.check_output(["/workspace/scratch/fe8de3b42084/verification-tools/rtk","proxy","git","-C",str(ROOT/"agent-dev-kit"),"show",HEAD+":tests/test_skill_command_examples.py"])
assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()=="408ef93e0128ec81773e68b6e903956ae5e300956096ac5eed3ba5189a0e7638"
m=ModuleType("fixed_snapshot_review")
m.__file__=str(SOURCE)
exec(compile(raw,str(SOURCE),"exec"),m.__dict__)
result={"started_at":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),"candidate":HEAD,"source_sha256":hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
        "scope":"Fake procfs, fixed clock and simulated signal acknowledgements only; no real process or signal"}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=OUT,prefix="report-cap-proc-") as d:
    root=Path(d)
    def write(pid,state="S"):
        p=root/str(pid)
        p.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        (p/"stat").write_text(f"{pid} (owned) {state} 1 {pid} 9000 0 0 0 0 0 0 0 7 8 0 0 0 0 0 0 99\n")
        task=p/"task"/str(pid)
        task.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        (task/"children").write_text("")
    for pid in range(9000,9009):
        write(pid)
    status=m.process_status
    snapshot=m.owned_process_snapshot
    state={}
    calls=[]
    batches=[]
    killed=[]
    def read(pid,**kw):
        return status(pid,proc_root=root)
    def page(sid,deadline,*,scan_state):
        value=snapshot(sid,deadline,proc_root=root,scan_state=scan_state)
        batches.append({"status":value["status"],"pids":[p["pid"] for p in value["processes"]]})
        return value
    def terminate(record,sid,deadline):
        killed.append(record["pid"])
        write(record["pid"],"Z")
        # Model different owned descendants appearing across otherwise complete passes.
        if len(killed)==9:
            for pid in range(9001,9009):
                shutil.rmtree(root/str(pid))
            for pid in range(9009,9017):
                write(pid)
        if len(killed)==17:
            for pid in range(9009,9017):
                shutil.rmtree(root/str(pid))
        return True
    with mock.patch("time.monotonic",return_value=100), mock.patch.object(m,"process_status",side_effect=read), \
            mock.patch.object(m,"owned_process_snapshot",side_effect=page), \
            mock.patch.object(m,"terminate_owned_process",side_effect=terminate):
        leader=read(9000)
        initial=page(9000,101,scan_state=state)
        try:
            outcome=m.cleanup_owned_session(leader,initial,101,scan_state=state)
        finally:
            m.close_owned_scan(state)
    result.update(cleanup_result=outcome,batches=batches,simulated_signal_pids=killed,
                  accumulated_report=state["report"],
                  counterexample_confirmed=(outcome=="complete" and state["report"].get("records_truncated") is True
                                            and state["report"]["status"]=="bounded"))
result["ended_at"]=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
result["collector_exit_code"]=0 if result["counterexample_confirmed"] else 1
p=OUT/"accumulated-report-cap-result.json"
assert not p.exists()
p.write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k!="accumulated_report"} | {"report_status":result["accumulated_report"]["status"],"records_truncated":result["accumulated_report"].get("records_truncated"),"diagnostic_record_count":len(result["accumulated_report"]["processes"])},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
raise SystemExit(result["collector_exit_code"])
